entry.title: BYSUS
entry.text: BYSUS, in botany, a genus of molltes belonging to the cryptogania alge. The character is taken from this reconnillacs, that they are covered with a female capillary filament or down, refonishing fat duft. The feeices are 15; all natives of Britain.
